kras.kra: Job updates to customers on time

goals.goal_name: Raise the share of leads assigned to me that book a service within 7 days
goals.baseline: 1.7% of assigned leads booked within 7 days in Aug-2026; 3% by 31-Dec-2026, 5% by 31-Mar-2027
goals.how: Measured from CY Admin (conversion_pct) against a target of 5%.

goals.goal_name: Finish every scheduled follow-up and callback by its due time
goals.baseline: 60 of 82 follow-ups overdue on 27-Sep-2026; fewer than 5 overdue at the end of each working day
goals.how: Measured from CY Admin (followups_on_time_pct) against a target of 95%, latest full month.

goals.goal_name: Ask every customer whose job I handle for a rating, and follow up on every low one
goals.target: Rating from half of delivered jobs, from Jan-2027
goals.baseline: 18 of 19 ratings recorded read 1; the capture is being fixed
goals.how: Your manager updates this after each review.

goals.goal_name: Make sure each customer gets every status update (estimate, work start, ready, delivered)
goals.kra: Job updates to customers on time
goals.target: 95% of my active jobs, every month from Nov-2026
goals.how: Your manager updates this after each review.

goals.goal_name: Give every lead assigned to me a status within 48 hours
goals.baseline: about 42% of assigned leads had no status in Sep-2026; under 10% by 31-Dec-2026
goals.how: Measured from CY Admin (leads_statused_48h_pct) against a target of 100%, latest full month.
